milestones.title: Equities Literacy
milestones.coachTip: Open Training → Equities literacy. Optional Coach → Name the equity building blocks. Archive terms sit under Reference.

milestones.title: Statement Snapshot
milestones.coachTip: Open Training → Statements literacy, then Coach → Read a SAMPLE company snapshot. Profit vs cash before any earnings case.

milestones.title: Chart Fluency
milestones.coachTip: Open Training → Indicators, then Charts on a SAMPLE equity pack. Coach → Why Indicators come before cases. Optional: Learn → Misc Practices → Lookalikes or Pattern hunt.

milestones.title: Earnings Cases
milestones.coachTip: Open Cases → earnings. Start with beat or miss. Coach → Beat vs miss on a SAMPLE report.

milestones.title: Company News Cases
milestones.coachTip: Open Cases → company news. Coach → Chase vs fade a company headline, or Short versus sell.
